hash_methods.picture_sha256: SHA-256 of entire named MP4 file bytes, including container and all streams; not stream packets or decoded frames
hash_methods.output_sha256: SHA-256 of entire named MP4 file bytes, including container and all streams; not stream packets or decoded frames
hash_methods.video_packet_sha256: SHA-256 of concatenated first-video-stream encoded packet payloads; ffmpeg -map 0:v:0 -c copy -f hash -hash sha256; excludes container metadata and audio; not decoded frames
hash_methods.aac_packet_sha256: SHA-256 of concatenated encoded first-audio-stream packet payloads; ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c copy -f hash -hash sha256
